title: Rich Dad Alternatives
h1: Rich Dad vs our wealth plan
keyLine: The book changes how you see a job. Our plan writes 12 months from your file.
description: Rich Dad Poor Dad compared with Legacy Wealth Blueprint: mindset book vs a written wealth plan, Preston Seo's path, and public digital prices. No public tuition.
answer: Rich Dad Poor Dad is a mindset book by Robert Kiyosaki. The [Rich Dad site](https://www.richdad.com/) still sells that view: your house can be a liability, some debt can buy assets, school trains workers. That is a story, not a how-to. Legacy Wealth Blueprint is what Preston Seo built after a corporate job, a house-hacked duplex, and a $15M+ portfolio with his wife: a written 12-month order for tax, debt, income, investing, and protection, plus a dedicated guide and a CPA brief. Read the book once if you need a jolt. Use us when you want one written order, not another parable. We do not publish our tuition here.

blocks.heading: What Preston teaches instead of another origin story
paragraphs: [Preston Seo](/about) is a first-generation immigrant's son. He took a corporate job after college and left within a year. He house-hacked a duplex while in sales. With his wife he built a $15M+ real estate portfolio. Seven years sit between 2017 debt and that figure. He founded Legacy Investing Show in 2020.

[Legacy Wealth Blueprint](/legacy-wealth-blueprint) is the 12-month plan from that work: a Wealth Strategy Snapshot, a dedicated guide, weekly coaching, 100+ lessons, a spouse seat, and a CPA Implementation Brief. You keep your CPA. You do not have to buy a rental on day one. Named client work is on [reviews](/reviews).

blocks.heading: What Rich Dad sells now
paragraphs: The book is the core product. People still argue about it. [BiggerPockets has published posts](https://www.biggerpockets.com/blog/rich-dad-poor-dad-investing-principles-good-or-bad) saying the book is motivation, not a manual. That matches how we use it: a start, not a process.

Rich Dad also sells small digital offers. A [Wealth Experts membership page](https://study.richdad.com/we-offer?oid=741&source_id=website_investing_RDWE) listed a 14-day trial, then $17 a month, cancel any time. A [beginner real estate course offer](https://study.richdad.com/re-course-offer) listed $27 for a five-part video. Coaching and live events are marketed on other Rich Dad URLs without a clear public tuition on the pages we opened. If someone quotes a five-figure 'Rich Dad seminar' price, ask for the live invoice. We will not invent it.

blocks.heading: If you only needed mechanics
paragraphs: Free BiggerPockets forums teach models after the why. The [FOO guide](https://moneyguy.com/guide/foo/) is a free order for this month's dollar. Those are starting tools, not a third trophy. See [BiggerPockets or Rich Dad vs our wealth plan](/compare/biggerpockets-vs-rich-dad) if you are still sorting the book from the forum.

blocks.label: Sales calls after a cheap video
paragraphs: Cheap $17 or $27 offers sometimes sit in front of a longer sales path. That is legal. It is also how people overpay. Take a night. Read the [FTC coaching page](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/when-business-offer-or-coaching-program-scam). If they rush you, walk.

faqs.q: Is Rich Dad Poor Dad still worth reading?
faqs.a: As a short mindset book, many investors still start there. As a buying manual, no. You need another source for offers, loans, and tax.

faqs.q: How much is Rich Dad coaching?
faqs.a: We could not copy a public coaching tuition from the homepages we opened. Digital offers showed $17 a month and $27. Ask for the full price in writing if a call starts.

faqs.q: Is Blueprint a Rich Dad alternative?
faqs.a: Only if you want a written 12-month order instead of another story. It is not a sequel to the novel.
